commit_message: Complete ADR0154 portable motion and target-aware authoring
pr_title: Implement ADR 0154 target-aware animation motion binding
pr_body:
Continues ADR 0154 first-release implementation on current main: import/reimport owns portable HumanoidMotion output, VMD persists an explicit Humanoid source-model provenance without conflating concrete motion_model_sources, provenance participates in import fingerprint/cache invalidation, Scene Bridge consumes imported portable motion instead of synthesizing it lazily, Animation Set Target Preview exposes shared-planner Native/Retarget/Humanoid/Failed routes, and package reachability consumes the same planner without creating portable source motion.

The PR remains Draft and must not be merged automatically.
